item.title: Location Sections Should Sell Capacity
item.description: A location section should do more than list addresses. Use it to explain reach, capacity, trust, and the next step a buyer should take.

item.title: Your Social Links Need to Live in Two Places (And Most Sites Only Have One)
item.description: Adding social profiles to your website footer isn't enough for GEO. Learn why your Instagram and TikTok links also need to be in your JSON-LD schema's sameAs array — and why both sides working together is what AI actually reads.

item.title: From 35 to 93: What Actually Moves Structured Data Scores for Local Businesses
item.description: Most local businesses have one schema type and call it done. Here's what it looks like to go from a skeleton structured data setup to a complete machine-readable identity layer — and why 58 points of improvement matters for AI visibility.

item.title: Wikidata: The Free AI Citation Multiplier Nobody Told Local Businesses About
item.description: ChatGPT references Wikipedia or Wikidata in nearly half its responses. Most local businesses don't exist there. Here's how to fix that in 20 minutes.

item.title: The New SEO Playbook: How to Optimize for Google AND AI in 2026
item.description: Search has changed. Beyond Google SEO, your website now needs to speak to ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity. Here's the complete technical guide to modern search optimization including llms.txt, enhanced schema markup, and AI discovery files.
